title: Which country has the most women in parliament?
subtitle: Two clues, four flags: find the country whose parliament is nearly two-thirds women, then learn how it got there and what seats can't tell you.
shape: 4 (mystery country, clues) + 6 (a quizzes b and viewer; b guesses Sweden, then plays the sceptic; a closes)
form: choose on the figure (tap a drawn flag)
notes: OWID (V-Dem) 2025: Rwanda 63.8 %, Cuba 55.7 %, Iceland 46 %, Sweden 45 %, world 27 %. Twist from OWID's political-regime chart (V-Dem Regimes of the World): Rwanda electoral autocracy, Cuba closed autocracy. Quota fact from UN Women. Two 100-seat populations side by side (Rwanda 64, world 27). Population of 100 lays out 15 per row with a short last row.
